links.outcome: Translation accuracy of GPT-o1 versus Google Translate rated by medical interpreters
links.effect: GPT-o1 achieved significantly higher translational accuracy (median 4.0 vs 3.0; P < .001), higher language register scores, and higher comprehensibility than Google Translate in all languages tested.
links.quote: GPT-o1 achieved significantly higher translational accuracy (median, 4.0 vs 3.0; P < .001) and higher language register scores and was rated more comprehensible than Google Translate in all languages tested.

unlisted_practices: LLM simplification and multilingual translation of radiology reports for patients with limited English proficiency

screen.reason: Evaluated the feasibility and performance of GPT-o1 for translating and simplifying radiology reports using expert radiologists and professional medical interpreters on retrospective reports, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
